description_en: Queries resources to which a specified tag is added or resources to which a specified tag is not added
kebab_example: aliyun tag list-resources-by-tag --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type ALIYUN::VPC::VPC --tag-filter-key k1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListResourcesByTag

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

For more information about region IDs, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2330902.html
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

关于地域ID的详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2330902.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The token that is used to start the next query
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Default value: 50. Maximum value: 1000
parameters.help_zh:
分页时每页显示的数据条数。

默认值：50。最大值：1000
parameters.name: max_result

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. This parameter specifies a filter condition for the query.

If you set the FuzzyType parameter to EQUAL, you can set this parameter to a value obtained from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2330915.html operation.
If you set the FuzzyType parameter to NOT, you can set this parameter to a resource type provided in Types of resources that support queries based on the NOT operator
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型，用于查询的过滤条件。取值：
FuzzyType=EQUAL时，支持的资源类型请调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2330915.html获取。

FuzzyType=NOT时，支持的资源类型请参见下文支持逻辑非查询的资源类型
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the query. Valid values:

EQUAL: exact match for resources to which the specified tag is added. This is the default value.
NOT: exact match for resources to which the specified tag is not added
parameters.help_zh:
查询操作。取值：

EQUAL（默认值）：精确查询绑定了指定标签的资源。
NOT：精确查询未绑定指定标签的资源
parameters.name: fuzzy_type

parameters.help_en:
The tag value. This parameter specifies a filter condition for the query.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
标签值，用于查询的过滤条件。

最多支持128个字符，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
parameters.name: tag_filter_value

parameters.help_en:
The tag key. This parameter specifies a filter condition for the query.

The tag key can be a maximum of 128 characters in length. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://` and cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`
parameters.help_zh:
标签键，用于查询的过滤条件。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
parameters.name: tag_filter_key

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return the information of tags added to the resources. Valid values:

False: does not return the information of tags added to the resources. This is the default value.
True: returns the information of all tags added to the resources
parameters.help_zh:
是否返回资源上的标签信息。取值：

False（默认值）：不返回资源上的标签信息。
True ：返回资源上所有标签信息
parameters.name: include_all_tags

NextToken.description_en:
Indicates whether the `next query` is required.

If the value of this parameter is empty (`"NextToken": ""`), all results are returned, and the `next query` is not required.
If the value of this parameter is not empty, the next query is required, and the value is the `token` used to start the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
根据`NextToken`判断是否具备下一个查询开始的Token。取值：

如果`NextToken`为空，即`"NextToken": ""`，表示没有下一个。
如果`NextToken`有值，则该值就是下一个查询开始的Token
NextToken.title_en: 表示当前调用返回读取到的位置，空或者空字符串代表数据已经读取完毕
NextToken.title_zh: 表示当前调用返回读取到的位置，空或者空字符串代表数据已经读取完毕

Tags.description_en:
The information of the tags.

This parameter is returned only if the `IncludeAllTags` parameter is set to `True`
Tags.description_zh:
标签信息。

当`IncludeAllTags`为`True`时，返回该参数

items.description_zh:
标签信息。

当`IncludeAllTags`为`True`时，返回该参数

Category.description_en:
The type of the tag. Valid values:

custom
system
Category.description_zh:
资源标签类型。取值：

custom：自定义标签。
system：系统标签
